pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions unless existing trades are running in a minimum +$5.00 profit with break-even stop locked.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a volatility expansion filter (ATR breakout confirmation) prior to order execution to avoid tight-range noise whipsaws.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume at +$10.00 and trail the remaining position with a dynamic ATR step-stop to capture +$15 to +$30 runs.
